senses.gloss: yvāgū, ˚gu, f. (= BHS and Pali yāgu, Skt. yavāgū; see 〔§ 3.118〕; a MIndic form, not the Skt., was pronounced, i.e., always two syllables in vss), gruel: yvāgu-pāna LV 〔171.18〕 (vs; most mss. point to yv- but A yāgu-); yvāgūpānaṃ Mv 〔i.47.16〕; 〔48.15〕; 〔335.9〕; 〔336.17〕; yvāgū ti 〔i.28.10〕; 〔29.6〕; yvāgū (mss. pyagu) 〔111.10〕; yvāgūye 〔ii.84.10〕 (gen.), yvāgu 13 and yvāgū 16 (n. sg.), see s.v. kṣudra 2.
